messages:
rafa: quick syncwe saw a Dedicated tenant trigger hard 429s during a rerank+embed burst. want a robust degrade ordering.
meera: details? was it queue overflow or admission policy?
kai: admission enforced hard throttle when worker_qtime > 1200ms for 8s. binary fail is bad for mixed workloads.
abby: proposal: (A) variant downgrade for non-chat routes, (B) short ingress token-bucket queue (<=30s window), (C) sampled soft-shed responses, (D) 429 last. Also add hysteresis to avoid flips.
rafa: per-route policy please. embeddings tolerate latency; chat doesn't. so route-specific priority solves that.
meera: canary step before downgrade: run 5 fast prompts on candidate variant and compare scores. if delta > threshold, prefer longer queue.
kai: telemetry: emit degrade_event with tenant, route, stage, reason, variant_from/to, sample_id. Console needs visibility.
abby: memory concern: avoid unbounded in-process queues. use bounded ring buffer + edge backpressure instead. token-bucket refill into serving pool.
rafa: billing note: bill by actual variant used and show adjustments in cost breakdown. transparency avoids surprises.
meera: for abuse detection, require abuse_score > 0.85 to skip graceful steps and go to probation. log and notify CS.
kai: private deployments: add tenant flag `degrade_preference: [quality, latency, drop]` default=latency. on-prem can opt-out of automatic variant swaps.
abby: rollout: internal canaries -> beta customers -> global. progressive ramping: start at 10% of low-priority tenants.
ops-bot: created ticket INF-6110: "Degrade ordering, token-bucket ingress, and canary evaluator" assigned eng-platform. :white_check_mark:
rafa: i'll own the RFC. will post draft in 3 days.
meera: i'll design canary evaluator and sample set.
kai: i'll prototype bounded ring buffer and token-bucket.
abby: i'll update runbook snippets and customer comms.
rafa: thanks all  let's avoid surprise 429s next time. :thumbsup:
